sequence.preserve: Complete typing, then reviewed proof photos and reading hold.
Stable original item IDs move to the declared complete order; show opinion basis.
Blue location reveal with original portrait footage.
Footage and phrase reveals share the scene; preserve source proportions.
White graph with persistent nodes, progress actor and adjacent evidence video.
Same graph continues on dark background; right evidence and matching presenter card avoid the graph.
Completion copy, matching presenter and five reviewed photos enter around the presenter.

fixed_effect_rules: Preserve checker and iris handoffs, existing entry/exit/morph timing and timed sound design.
Add or replace footage inside its supported slot; do not replace the graph or another defining mechanism to make room.
A matching partial presenter stays on its original narration interval across scene changes.
Changed voice duration requires actual-caption-based scene/cue planning and new review; do not scale the whole choreography or speech.
reuse_entry: Copy the approved source-bound v7 draft in the existing template library, then use the ordinary preflight/freeze/queue/recovery workflow.
scope: Approved portrait look and its seven-scene recipe. Other mechanisms, arbitrary new scripts, landscape evidence windows and other machines keep their separate validation states. This policy is not a fabricated source-bound production input.
